definitions.full: H2117. Zaza זָזָא proper name, masculine (perhaps belongs under this √; compare Assyrian proper name Zazâ Zim BP 97 compare Strm AV No. 2816 ) — a descendant of יְרַחְמְאֵל of Judah 1Chr 2:33 .
